notablePrerequisites:
Nature's Chosen attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Wild Growth attached to Vault of Catlacan.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least six artifacts.
description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan's second ability by tapping it, adding six {U}.
Wild Growth triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Nature's Chosen's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Nature's Chosen from the battlefield to your hand, and then returning Capsize to your hand.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, attaching it to Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

uses.name: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan
